mvp_baseline: Owner-approved local-first Windows sales core P0; P1 modules optional; execution authorization remains limited to D-21, D-22, D-30, D-31, D-32 and the D-33 presentation-only UI scope.
change_summary: The stock page action column now uses icons with a uniform painted area: the flat stock-taking list icon (18x12 of the 24x24 canvas) was replaced by a clipboard-with-check icon (20x20), matching the edit and activate/deactivate icons; the same icon is used in the product edit dialog.
In narrow layout the menu button is no longer an empty blue box: it is now a labelled control with a visible three-bar SVG icon, while the hidden checkbox keeps keyboard access.
The navigation menu in narrow layout is now an off-canvas drawer that slides in from the side over a dimming backdrop instead of sitting in the document flow and pushing all content down.
The quick settings panel and its backdrop keep higher stacking layers (1040/1035) than the drawer and its backdrop (1030/1025), so opening quick settings is unchanged in both narrow and wide layouts.
Wide layout is unchanged: the sidebar remains 250 px wide and sticky, and the menu button stays hidden.
Only presentation changed; no money, data, permission or database semantics were touched.

In narrow layout the top-bar text labels (the local-mode status, the cashier/admin name and the role) are now hidden so they no longer wrap and overlap inside the 56 px bar; the green status dot and the user icon remain as the visible indicators, and the full text is available in a title tooltip on hover or long press.
The wide layout is unchanged: the same labels remain visible in the top bar on screens wider than 640.98 px.
The navigation drawer and the quick settings panel keep their behavior and stacking; no money, data, permission or database semantics were touched.
review_findings: Build after the change: dotnet build Wizz.Presentation -c Release = 0 errors (pre-existing StyleCop warnings only).
Solution tests after the change: Domain 24/24; Integration 262/262 (286 total).

Browser measurement inside a 430 px frame: before the change the sidebar was 422 px wide and 67 px high, content started at 123 px, and the old hamburger was a 56x40 empty blue box; after the change content starts at 56 px, the sidebar is fixed off-screen at x = 430, and the hamburger is a visible 41.6x40 control with three SVG lines.

Drawer check in the same 430 px frame: clicking the hamburger moves the sidebar from x = 430 to x = 126 (304 px wide), the backdrop becomes fully opaque, the article stays at y = 56; clicking the backdrop closes the drawer (x = 430, visibility hidden).

Quick settings check in narrow layout: opening quick settings while the drawer is open keeps the panel at z-index 1040 and its backdrop at 1035, above the drawer at 1030 and its backdrop at 1025; the panel opens and closes normally.
Wide-layout check at 1000 px: sidebar is sticky, 250 px wide, at x = 750; the hamburger and drawer backdrop are hidden; the quick settings trigger remains visible.
Stock icon check on a separate temporary database copy: all three action icons have a 20x20 painted bounding box and 16x16 SVG elements, with identical 34x31 buttons; no console errors.

Limitation: the 286 automated tests do not cover browser layout, icon geometry or drawer behavior; the evidence above is manual and was not reproduced in CI because GitHub Actions remains unavailable for the account.
Boundary note: the changes are presentation-only; money, stock and permission settings stay in the full settings page and were not altered.
Execution remains unauthorized outside the recorded limited scopes (D-21, D-22, D-30, D-31, D-32, D-33).
Phase 3 (cash drawer, purchases, UI, sync) is not implemented and not authorized.
MVP-AT-09 still requires a real restore test in a separate environment.
